Dear Marcel,
I would suggest you try the aroma.affymetrix mailing list which I am cc'ing, because you will get much more assistance there. First of all, the FIRMA results are returned per probeset (i.e. exon) not per gene. I think NA usually is because there is only one probe per probeset (or maybe one probeset per gene too, I don't remember right now). 
Best,
